NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>SOURCE shows a front-left view of a two-storey white volume with a thin roof edge, two upper front glazed openings, one broad ground-floor sliding opening, two stacked narrow left windows, a projecting glass-railed balcony, a full-height timber strip at front right, a grey plinth and an extended paved terrace. CURRENT retains these principal facade elements, but the ground-floor opening nearly touches the balcony underside and the terrace is missing. Balcony returns appear connected in the supplied views; concealed joints cannot be verified. Rear, right facade and roof surface are unobserved in SOURCE. The stated 1200 mm railing height cannot be verified from screenshots.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: CURRENT leaves only a narrow strip above the ground-floor glazing; SOURCE shows a substantially deeper white header below the balcony soffit.
action: Locally lower the ground-floor opening head and resize its frame/glazing, retaining its sill and width. Match the source-visible soffit-to-head clearance.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="source-matched">problem: SOURCE has a paved terrace projecting beyond the front and visible left wall. CURRENT terminates at a narrow base flush with the building.
action: Add the visible low terrace slab around the front and left side, matching its projection and thin exposed edge without inventing hidden extents.</issue>
<keep>Two upper front openings with central vertical divisions.
Broad two-panel ground-floor glazing arrangement.
Two vertically aligned narrow windows on the left facade.
Full-height vertical timber strip at the front-right edge.
Thin visible roof-edge coping.</keep>
